text:
maria: Quick pre-sync note: prototyping a compact "quiet periods" row for the alert preview. Goals: reduce vertical noise, show per-medium grouping (Pager / Email / Slack), and provide a clear mobile fallback. Mock: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/quiet-periods-row-proto.png

anil: A11y checklist: linear reading order for screen readers, role=list/listitem for the timeline, aria-posinset/aria-setsize, and non-color indicators for overlaps. Also ensure focus targets meet 3:1 contrast.

lisa: Copy suggestion: use "Quiet periods" (sentence case) in the UI and helper text: "Temporarily pause notifications for selected channels." Tooltip for system silences: "Auto-snooze (policy)".

devin: Implementation note: avoid rendering a segment per channel for large teams. Server should return grouped windows with counts to keep the frontend cheap. Proposed payload: quiet_periods: [{group: 'Pager', start:'', end:'', count:2, source:'auto'}].

jake: Keyboard flow: roving tabindex; announce "Quiet periods timeline, N items. Use left/right to navigate." Enter opens the edit modal. Use polite live region updates when items change.

tara: Mobile: show a compact pill ("3 channels quiet") that expands into a bottom sheet with the timeline and per-channel rows. No hover-only affordances.

maria: Action items: 1) mocks (maria) 2) a11y micro-spec (anil) 3) finalize copy & tooltips (lisa) 4) API grouped payload + coalescing (devin) 5) keyboard nav doc (jake). I'll upload updated art before the sync.
